DevExtreme

DevExtreme is our award-winning, enterprise-ready UI component suite for today’s most popular front-end frameworks: Angular, React, Vue, and jQuery.

 

Our modern JavaScript/TypeScript component suite includes data grids, pivot tables, interactive charts, data editors, navigation, and multi-purpose UI components. DevExtreme component libraries are responsive and support accessibility standards. They address a broad range of use case scenarios and are optimized to work as expected across different devices, screen sizes, and input methods.

 Resources

- Components - a complete list of available DevExtreme UI components
- Documentation - guides and APIs
- Demos - interactive examples with source code
- Responsive UI Templates - a set of pre-built app modules for use in your next great DevExtreme-powered project

 License

DevExtreme requires a paid license for commercial use. For additional information on pricing and licensing terms, please visit the following:

- Pricing
- Licensing

Explore DevExtreme at your own pace with our Free 30-Day Trial version.

 Release Notes

For our latest release notes, refer to the What's New section of DevExpress.com

 Get Started

Follow the guides below to add DevExtreme components to your app:

Angular React Vue jQuery

Using AI agents to build a DevExtreme app? Check out our AI-assisted development tools (MCP Server and AI Agent Skills).

 Support and Feedback

To report a bug, request a feature, or ask a question, submit a ticket via the DevExpress Support Center (available to customers with an active DevExtreme license).
